topic: Hidden in app store subscriptions audit vs ignoring them (Zane vs Bree)

scenes.narration: Thought he paid forty monthly. Real number was three hundred. Today's training session begins now!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault in a gym holding up a phone with a long subscription list on screen, comic burst banner reads THREE HUNDRED TWELVE A MONTH, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Zane and Bree both think they pay forty for streaming and apps.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man zane and woman bree both on couches with phones, identical thought bubbles reading ONLY FORTY DOLLARS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Both have the same iPhone and the same casual download habits.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, two identical iPhone screens floating in the panel, each crowded with app icons, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Zane never opens his subscriptions list in iPhone settings.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, zane on a couch with a phone, the SETTINGS icon unopened with a thick layer of dust, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: He still pays for free trials he forgot to cancel years ago.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, app icons floating around zane labeled FREE TRIAL FORGOTTEN, calendar pages flipping by, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Bree spends ten minutes once a quarter on subscriptions cleanup.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, bree on a couch with a phone and a small clock showing TEN MINUTES, a calendar marked EVERY QUARTER, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She opens Apple ID, taps subscriptions, and cancels anything unused.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, bree's phone showing a SUBSCRIPTIONS LIST with several lines crossed out, comic banner reads CANCEL CANCEL CANCEL, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Zane finally opens his list and counts twenty one active subscriptions.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, shocked zane at a kitchen table with a phone showing a long list of TWENTY ONE subscriptions, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Total is three hundred twelve dollars a month, thirty seven hundred yearly.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, zane's phone showing TOTAL THREE HUNDRED TWELVE A MONTH and a comic banner reading THIRTY SEVEN HUNDRED YEARLY, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Bree pays forty seven dollars a month total across all apps.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, bree at a coffee table with a clean phone screen reading FORTY SEVEN A MONTH, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She saved three thousand a year for ten quarterly minutes.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, bree holding a savings app reading THREE THOUSAND SAVED, a small clock reading TEN MINUTES beside it, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Audit subscriptions every ninety days. Drop and give me twenty bucks!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault blowing a whistle, holding a clipboard reading SUBSCRIPTIONS AUDIT EVERY NINETY DAYS, comic burst banner reads TWENTY BUCKS, kids comic book illustration
